bio.text: Michael Tannousis has represented Assembly District 64, covering parts of southern Brooklyn and the East Shore of Staten Island, since he was elected on November 3, 2020.
He began in public service in 2006 as an aide to then-City Council Minority Leader James Oddo, and later worked as an assistant district attorney in the Bronx and, from 2016, in Richmond County.
He is a lifelong Staten Islander with an undergraduate degree from SUNY Binghamton and a J.D. from Pace Law School.
